subject: Win Playbook: Evaluation Acceptance Gates + Test Catalog
messages:
From: Erin White <erin.white@medica.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@medica.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation plan / next steps

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Carlos and I want to make sure we have a tight mutual action plan before we kick off the trial week. Two asks to start:

1) Can you send a concise MAP that lists milestones, owners, and a close timeline? We need to articulate success metrics for our internal sign-off.
2) We also want an acceptance-test catalog (smoke tests + data quality checks) so our engineers can validate outputs during the pilot.

High level we care about: 99th percentile latency at 95% of payloads, top-line precision on entity extraction > 92% on our sampling, and reproducible deterministic outputs for templated prompts.

If possible can you share a draft by EOD tomorrow? We have a product review on Friday and want to align with procurement.

Thanks,
Erin White
Director, Product
Medica Health

[attachment: soc2-evidence-request.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@medica.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jul 2025 14:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Win Playbook: Evaluation Acceptance Gates + Test Catalog

Erin —

Appreciate the clarity. I’ve attached a first-pass MAP (MAP-v1.xlsx) and a short acceptance-tests.md that maps each test to an owner, success threshold, and sample data source. Quick summary below so you can share with your review: 

- Timeline: 2-week pilot (trial week + 1 week verification), target decision: 2025-07-24.
- Exit gates (must pass all to sign):
  • Latency: 99th percentile <= 350ms for 90% of requests (measured on our staging load).
  • Accuracy: Named-entity F1 >= 92% on your labeled sample set (we’ll provide evaluation harness).
  • Stability: Generation determinism for templated prompts (<= 2% token variance across 10 runs).
  • Integration: Embedding similarity baseline (cosine >= 0.88 for positive pairs).

- Acceptance tests included: smoke inference, NER concordance, edge-case prompts, rate-limit burst test, KV-cache warmup check, and end-to-end throughput verification.
- Owners: Rishi (trial orchestration & observability), Lauren (test harness & concordance), Marissa (customer success & rollout play).

I’ve also listed contingencies — a canary fallback to a quantized variant if costs spike, and a rollback path if latency regressions occur. If that aligns, I’ll update the MAP with specific calendar events and link the HubSpot deal.

I attached: MAP-v1.xlsx, acceptance-tests.md

Next steps: can we block 30 minutes tomorrow (Tue 7/8) to walk through the acceptance-tests and agree on sample data ownership?

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Looping in a few technical specifics from our side — forwarding Rishi’s draft and adding acceptance-test detail.

On Tue, Jul 8, 2025 at 2:27 PM PDT, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Erin —
> 
> Appreciate the clarity. I’ve attached a first-pass MAP (MAP-v1.xlsx) and a short acceptance-tests.md ...

Erin — quick notes from engineering: 
- Evaluation harness: we’ll push an evaluation runner that consumes your labeled set (CSV + JSONL) and returns a per-test F1/precision/recall with a reproducible seed. Owner: Lauren.
- Latency measurement: we instrument at the token and request layer; we’ll provide an SLO dashboard and 5-minute rolling P95/P99. Owner: Rishi (observability on infra), Ops lead TBD.
- Pass/fail for NER: F1 >= 92% on the labeled sample OR precision >= 93% if recall dips (we’ll surface confusion matrix).
- Edge-case gating: we’ll run a curated 120-example edge-case suite; any single critical failure (hallucinated PHI, data leakage) triggers an immediate pause of the trial and a joint triage.

I’ll add inline test steps to acceptance-tests.md and update the MAP calendar. Marissa — can you confirm CS availability for the verification week?

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks, team — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side:

- The SOC2 evidence is a hard ask for procurement; I attached a short checklist of required artifacts (soc2-evidence-request.pdf). Can you confirm you can supply the items or an equivalent attestation during the trial?
- For determinism we care about token-level variance for templated billing prompts specifically; can we create a 20-prompt templated suite and include it in the edge-case run?
- Timeline tweak: procurement needs final acceptance criteria by Thu 7/17 to get legal review scheduled. Can you update the MAP calendar to show internal sign-off milestone on 7/17 and a go/no-go on 7/24?

Also, we’d like to schedule the 30-min alignment for Thu 7/10 at 10:00 PT if that works.
